sources.quote: HD 117618, named Dofida by the IAU, is a single, yellow-hued star in the southern constellation of Centaurus.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.2 solar radii and 1.03 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,847 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
